title: Coordinating and subordinating conjunctions
spec: Conjunctions: co-ordinating (e.g. car, donc, ensuite) and subordinating (e.g. lorsque, puisque, comme)
summary: Coordinating conjunctions join two equal ideas: et (and), mais (but), ou (or), car (because), donc (so): Il pleut, donc je reste à la maison.
Sequencing words order events: d'abord (first), puis / ensuite (then), alors (so, then), enfin (finally).
car and parce que both mean because; car is a little more formal and cannot start a sentence; parce que becomes parce qu' before a vowel.
Subordinating conjunctions introduce a clause: quand / lorsque (when), puisque / comme (since, as), si (if), pendant que (while), parce que (because).
comme meaning as / since goes at the start of the sentence: Comme il pleuvait, nous sommes restés à la maison.
si becomes s' only before il and ils: s'il fait beau, but si elle vient.
After quand and lorsque, use the future when the action is in the future: Quand je serai grand, je serai médecin.
bien que (although) is followed by the subjunctive; you only need to recognise it: bien qu'il soit fatigué.

cards.front: Give the French for: and, but, or, because, so / therefore, then.
cards.back: et, mais, ou, car (or parce que), donc (or alors), puis / ensuite. J'aime le foot mais je préfère le tennis.

cards.prompt: J'aime le français ___ je n'aime pas les maths.
cards.en: I like French but I don't like maths.

cards.prompt: Tu préfères le thé ___ le café ?
cards.en: Do you prefer tea or coffee?
cards.why: ou (or) has no accent; où with an accent means where.

cards.prompt: Il pleuvait, ___ nous sommes restés à la maison.
cards.en: It was raining, so we stayed at home.
cards.why: donc or alors (so) introduces a result.

cards.prompt: D'abord, je prends une douche, ___ je m'habille.
cards.en: First I have a shower, then I get dressed.
cards.why: puis or ensuite (then) puts actions in order after d'abord (first); après is also used in everyday French.

cards.front: car or parce que: what is the difference?
cards.back: Both mean because. car is slightly more formal and cannot start a sentence. parce que can, and becomes parce qu' before a vowel: parce qu'il fait froid.

cards.prompt: J'aimerais travailler à l'étranger ___ j'adore voyager.
cards.en: I would like to work abroad because I love travelling.
cards.why: car or parce que (because) gives a reason; both are correct in the middle of a sentence.

cards.instruction: Join the two sentences with parce que.
cards.prompt: Elle est fatiguée. Elle a mal dormi.
answers: Elle est fatiguée parce qu'elle a mal dormi.
cards.en: She is tired because she slept badly.
cards.why: parce que gives the reason; que becomes qu' before a vowel: parce qu'elle.

cards.front: Give the French for: when (two ways), since / as (two ways), if, while.
cards.back: quand / lorsque, puisque / comme, si, pendant que. Lorsque je suis arrivé, il pleuvait. Puisque tu es là, aide-moi !

cards.prompt: ___ j'étais petit, j'habitais à la campagne.
cards.en: When I was little, I lived in the countryside.
cards.why: quand or lorsque (when) introduces a time clause; lorsque is slightly more formal.

cards.prompt: ___ tu es malade, tu devrais rester au lit.
cards.en: Since you're ill, you should stay in bed.
cards.why: puisque or comme (since, as) gives a reason that is already known; comme in this sense starts the sentence.

cards.prompt: Mon père fait la cuisine ___ ma mère lit le journal.
cards.en: My father does the cooking while my mother reads the newspaper.
cards.why: pendant que (while) links two actions happening at the same time.

cards.back: Only before il and ils: s'il pleut, s'ils viennent. It stays si before elle, on and other vowels: si elle veut, si on va au parc.

cards.instruction: Join the two sentences into one, starting with the French for 'if'. Keep the verbs as they are.
cards.prompt: Il pleut. Je reste à la maison.
answers: S'il pleut, je reste à la maison.
cards.en: If it rains, I stay at home.
cards.why: si introduces the condition and becomes s' before il: s'il pleut.

cards.front: Which tense follows quand or lorsque when you talk about the future?
cards.back: The future, unlike English: Quand j'aurai dix-huit ans, j'apprendrai à conduire (When I am eighteen...). Not quand j'ai dix-huit ans for a future event.

cards.prompt: Quand je ___ grand, j'habiterai au bord de la mer.
cards.en: When I'm older, I'll live by the sea.
cards.why: The action is in the future (j'habiterai), so quand is followed by the future tense too: je serai, not je suis.

cards.instruction: Join the two sentences into one, starting with Comme (as / since).
cards.prompt: Il pleuvait. Nous sommes restés à la maison.
answers: Comme il pleuvait, nous sommes restés à la maison.
cards.en: As it was raining, we stayed at home.
cards.why: comme meaning as / since introduces the reason and goes at the start of the sentence.

cards.front: What does bien que mean, and what is special about the verb after it?
cards.back: bien que = although. It is followed by the subjunctive, which you only need to recognise: Bien qu'il soit malade, il va au collège (Although he is ill, he goes to school).
